summary: The tax office has assessed your income tax for 2025. You still owe €312.40, payable by 5 November 2026. If the figures look wrong, you can file an appeal (Einspruch) within one month of official notification. An appeal doesn't automatically pause the payment deadline.

action_items.title: Pay the outstanding €312.40
action_items.details: Check the bank details in the original notice before paying. Use your tax number (Steuernummer) 37 012 345 67 and the tax year 2025 as the payment reference.

action_items.title: Check the tax calculation
action_items.details: Compare the figures with your tax return, including your work-related expenses (Werbungskosten). The appeal date below is only an estimate: it assumes official notification four days after the date on the letter. Check the actual notification date and the appeal instructions in the original.

action_items.title: Ask the tax office about anything unclear
action_items.details: Keep the notice and your tax number handy. Ask them to explain the outstanding balance or any work-related expenses that don't add up.
action_items.call_purpose_de: Rückfrage zum Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025 und zur Nachzahlung von 312,40 Euro.
